text:
morgan: hey all :wave: just joined as a product designer. quick access q — I get a 403 on the company Figma org and the roadmap doc link is 404. who should I DM for access?

tara: welcome! :tada: ping @design-ops for Figma and @pa-infra for Google Drive/docs. what email did you sign up with?

morgan: morgan@redwood.com

design-ops-bot: Hi Morgan! I've sent an invite to the 'Redwood Design' Figma team and shared 'Product Roadmap 2026' in Drive. Check your Figma invites (top-right) and your Google Drive -> Shared with me. Reply here if you don't see them.

sam: fyi I hit SSO weirdness on day 1 — if you see an Okta SSO error, try clearing cookies or open an incognito window. If it still fails I can escalate.

morgan: tried incognito, still 403. screenshot: [can't attach here]

liam: just re-sent a manual invite from design-ops. also double-check that Okta added you to the 'product-design' group. I added you to the research board in Notion too.

emily: quick note on research/process since you're on PD: roadmap doc has the onboarding checklist + research playbook. TL;DR: (1) repo of interview guides in the doc, (2) weekly reviewer slot on Mondays, (3) upload transcripts to Research Drive under /studies. ping me if you want to pair on your first study.

tara: adding @it because sometimes SSO tokens need a backend refresh.

design-ops-bot: Ticket created: IT-4321 for SSO token refresh. ETA ~2 hours.

sam: meanwhile I invited you to a drafts Figma file with limited perms so you can start mocking — check your Figma file browser under 'Shared'.

morgan: I can open the drafts file now, still waiting on org page access but can work in the meantime — thanks everyone! :relaxed: 

emily: welcome again — also add yourself to the weekly PD stand calendar (invite sent). I'll DM a short list of onboarding tasks for product designers (research tasks, design critique schedule, and who to ping for marketing assets).

liam: FYI roadmap lives at /product/strategy/Roadmap-2026 (view-only by default). If you need edit rights sooner, request 'editor' from @pm-lead or tell me and I'll fast-track it.

morgan: will do. really appreciate the fast help :heart:
